tools.description: Find vulnerability records that name any of the given products, newest first, with how each product was matched. Each name is resolved to a tracked product first; names that do not resolve are reported with suggestions and are not guessed. A container image reference such as nginx:1.25.3-alpine is n

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search across vulnerabilities, reporting and live incidents by CVE id, vendor, product, group or keyword. Ransomware leak-site claims are not included; they are shown on the website only. Entries whose title holds every search word come first, then the newest. Returns short entries with li

tools.name: breach_notices
tools.description: List data breach notices that organizations filed with US states and with HHS, newest filing first, one entry per breach with every filing, the people affected as the organization reported and the notice letters. A notice is filed by the organization itself and published as filed, not as a finding.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: recent_threats, check_packages · Private data: lookup_cve, recent_threats, lookup_cves, vulnerabilities_for_products, search, check_packages, changes_since · Public sink: check_packages, changes_since · Destructive: lookup_cve, recent_threats, lookup_cves, find_products, vulnerabilities_for_products, search, breach_notices, check_packages, changes_since, data_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: recent_threats, check_packages · Private data: lookup_cve, recent_threats, lookup_cves, vulnerabilities_for_products, search, check_packages, changes_since · Public sink: check_packages, changes_since · Destructive: lookup_cve, recent_threats, lookup_cves, find_products, vulnerabilities_for_products, search, breach_notices, check_packages, changes_since, data_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
